rows.fact: The claim that none of 39 pairs beats face density was not re-derived. This review did not run the owner's model.
The modulus closures, the Q 0.82 payload of about -40 t, and the gamma-cap payloads were not re-optimized on the independent route.
Optimistic and ISA lifts are the same number. COMMON states one pressure and one density. The stress difference between the weathers is not in that brief.
Reported Vc is 1.291 to 1.323, below 2, so the handbook step stays 0.20 if that rule is granted. The Vc formula is not in COMMON and was not recomputed.

Mass above faces, core and joining is 1404 kg at concept R 20 ISA and 3868 kg at concept R 30 ISA. Joining exceeds the two film sheets. COMMON's 5 percent joints plus 100 kg does not recover the split.
The payload match to DELTA-C within 0.0021 kg is a comparison of two outputs of the same model. It is not an independent derivation.
